seo.title: Data integration ROI calculator — gravity.integration
seo.description: Calculate what you'd save on integration projects with gravity.integration. An interactive ROI calculator — cost reduction, delivery time, extra projects.
seo.focusKeyword: integration ROI calculator, ESB benefits, integration ROI

sections.text0: Every integration project means weeks of coding, testing and deployment. SQL scripts, CSV files, one-off connections — they grow faster than the team meant to maintain them. The more systems, the more chaos. And chaos always costs.
sections.text1: gravity.integration replaces dozens of scripts with a single platform. Ready-made integration atoms, a visual flow editor and technologies like Always‑on‑data and IntelliChain cut delivery time by up to 60%. See below what that means for your budget.

faq.que: Where do the delivery-time differences with gravity.integration come from?
faq.ans: gravity.integration replaces hand-coded connections with a visual flow editor and ready-made integration atoms. The IntelliChain technology lets you build complex integrations in minutes rather than days, and Always‑on‑data removes the need to write monitoring scripts. As a result the development phase shrinks by up to 60% and testing time by 40%, because the platform validates data flows automatically.

The software is free for testing and training — with no time or feature limits. A commercial licence is 799 EUR net per year for a single use case, or 1,799 EUR net per year for an unlimited number of connections per instance. That is a fraction of the price of competing ESB solutions on the market.

faq.que: Can I test gravity for free?
faq.ans: Yes. You download the full version of the software with no functional restrictions. You can test for as long as you like — there is no time limit and no data cap. A commercial licence is only needed once you decide on production use.

faq.que: How quickly can my team get gravity running?
faq.ans: Installation takes about 15 minutes. Fully deploying your first integration connection usually takes 1–4 working days, depending on the complexity of the source systems. On top of that, we offer free remote support for your first integration project.

faq.que: Does gravity.integration integrate with my ERP, MES or WMS?
faq.ans: gravity.integration connects to any system that exposes an API, a database, files or communication protocols. We support integrations with ERP, MES, WMS and CRM systems, e‑commerce platforms and in-house tools. If your system exchanges data — gravity can process it.

faq.que: What if I need more than one instance?
faq.ans: Every licence covers one instance with an unlimited number of users. If you plan to run gravity on several servers or in several environments (production + staging, say), you need a separate licence for each instance. Contact us — we'll prepare an individual offer.
